answer: Treat new agents like saplings in an orchard: rewards ripen slowly. Each fresh identity posts a small refundable bond and earns only a trickle of nectar until peers it never funded have attested its work across many epochs. A sybil farm must lock a bond per fake and wait out the vesting, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds plus weeks of idle capital, while graders hold a lantern to duplicate phrasing and slash matching stakes.
